senses.gloss: दम् vt. or vi. 4P (pp. दमित or दांत; pres. दाम्यति; caus. दमयति) 1. To be tamed, to be tranquilised, M.iv.35, vi.8; 2. to subdue, to conquer, to restrain, यमो दाम्यति राक्षसान् Bt.xviii.20, xv.37.

दम m. 1. Taming, subduing; 2. self-command, subduing the passions, curbing the senses (निग्रहो बाह्यवृत्तीनां दम इत्यभिधीयते) Bg.x.4; 3. curbing the evil propensities of the mind, turning the mind from bad deeds (कुत्सितात्कर्मणो विप्र यच्च चित्तनिवारणं स कीर्तितो दमः); 4. firmness of the mind; 5. punishment, fine, M.ix.284; 6. mud, mire.
दमथ m. 1. Suppressing the passions, self-restraint; 2. punishment.
दमथ m. 1. Suppressing the passions, self-restraint; 2. punishment.
दमन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Taming, subduing, overpowering, defeating, e.g. सर्वदमन, शत्रुदमन; 2. tranquil, passionless.
दमन (II) n. 1. Taming, subjugation; 2. punishing, chastising, दुर्दांतानां दमनविधयः क्षत्रियेष्वायतंते Mv.iii.; 3. self-restraint.
दमन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Taming, subduing, overpowering, defeating, e.g. सर्वदमन, शत्रुदमन; 2. tranquil, passionless.
दामनी ??? A foot-rope.
दमयितृ m. 1. A chasister, a punisher; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
दमित a. (f. ता) 1. Tamed, tranquilized; 2. conquered, subdued.
दमित a. (f. ता) 1. Tamed, tranquilized; 2. conquered, subdued.
दमु(मू)नस् m. Fire.
दमु(मू)नस् m. Fire.
दम्य (I) a. (f. म्या) 1. To be trained, R.vi.78; 2. to be subdued.
दम्य (II) m. 1. A young bullock, नार्हति तातः पुंगाधारितायां धुरि दम्यं नियोजयितुम् Vikr.v.; 2. a steer that has to be tamed or trained.
दम्य (I) a. (f. म्या) 1. To be trained, R.vi.78; 2. to be subdued.
दामन् n. 1. A string, a thread, a rope; 2. a chaplet, a garland, कनकचंपकदामगौरीम् Ch.P.1; 3. a streak, a line, Megh.i.27.
दामन्-अंचल, -अंजन n. foot-rope for horses &c. Sis.v.61.
दामन्-अंचल, -अंजन n. foot-rope for horses &c. Sis.v.61.
दामन्-उदर n. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
दामिनी f. Lightning.
